items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I was in love with Stravinsky and Debussy, a little bit with Ravel.

ctx.x: I know what I said. Me and Spaulding Gibbons -- he called me Debussy, I called him Ravel, because I heard him play -- we was recording things on piano, and he sounded like Ravel to me. I sounded something like Debussy to him. (Inaudible) Before we realized that black people don't nothing for the get to play classical music or write (inaudible) symphony. on bass with Rheinschagen. Which I was studying for (inaudible). My dream was not to get a symphony orchestra to stay there, but we got to get in I figured I had…
